Attach self-attested photocopies of educational qualification certificates, experience certificates and other supporting documents.
Include contact number and email ID.
Submit to the Office of the District Rural Development Agency (Mini Secretariat), Resubelpara, North Garo Hills during office hours on or before 27-11-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SRES-DID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SRES-DID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for District Programme Manager (SBM-G).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SRES-DID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Standard Form) and send it to Office of the District Rural Development Agency (Mini Secretariat), Resubelpara, North Garo Hills, by by hand or post, to reach by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master Degree in Rural Development/ Social Work or PG Diploma in Rural Development or its equivalent from any reputed University/ Institution, with minimum 4 years of work experience in Rural Development or related fields.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only permanent residents of Meghalaya may apply.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Examination. Personal Interview of shortlisted candidates. Written examination for eligible candidates. Only candidates fulfilling the prescribed qualification and experience criteria will be considered.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual basis for a period of 1 (one) year. May be extended based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: North Garo Hills District, Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duly filled-in application in Standard Form; Self-attested photocopies of all relevant educational qualification certificates; Other supporting documents; Contact number and email ID.
